- Traditional Methods fall short
- Data Science as an Approach

<br>

## The Journey

- Started as an in-house workshop - RIntro2021

- Grew to a national workshop series

- Reviewed *Current Status and Scope for Public Health Data Science Education*

- UTFORSK Project, University of Oslo (Case Studies)

- DMgtAsia 

- Summer Schools @ IIT-Bombay & IISc- Bangalore (Residential)

- PHDMI 

- Transformative Training Model (TTM)
